title: Uniform Time-Course Simulation of Enzyme Kinetics
description: Foundational SED-ML L1V4 uniformTimeCourse experiment executing a CVODE trajectory on a companion Michaelis-Menten SBML enzymatic reaction model.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sedML xmlns="http://sed-ml.org/sed-ml/level1/version4" level="1" version="4">
  <listOfModels>
    <model id="model_mm" name="Michaelis-Menten Enzyme" language="urn:sedml:language:sbml" source="mm_enzyme.sbml"/>
  </listOfModels>
  <listOfSimulations>
    <uniformTimeCourse id="sim_tc" name="CVODE Time Course" initialTime="0" outputStartTime="0" outputEndTime="20" numberOfSteps="100">
      <algorithm kisaoID="KISAO:0000019" name="CVODE"/>
    </uniformTimeCourse>
  </listOfSimulations>
  <listOfTasks>
    <task id="task_mm" name="Enzyme Time Course" modelReference="model_mm" simulationReference="sim_tc"/>
  </listOfTasks>
  <listOfDataGenerators>
    <dataGenerator id="dg_time" name="Time">
      <listOfVariables>
        <variable id="t" symbol="urn:sedml:symbol:time" taskReference="task_mm"/>
      </listOfVariables>
      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>t</ci></math>
    </dataGenerator>
    <dataGenerator id="dg_S" name="Substrate">
      <listOfVariables>
        <variable id="S" target="/sbml:sbml/sbml:model/sbml:listOfSpecies/sbml:species[@id='S']" taskReference="task_mm"/>
      </listOfVariables>
      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>S</ci></math>
    </dataGenerator>
    <dataGenerator id="dg_P" name="Product">
      <listOfVariables>
        <variable id="P" target="/sbml:sbml/sbml:model/sbml:listOfSpecies/sbml:species[@id='P']" taskReference="task_mm"/>
      </listOfVariables>
      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>P</ci></math>
    </dataGenerator>
  </listOfDataGenerators>
  <listOfOutputs>
    <plot2D id="plot_enzyme" name="Substrate and Product Dynamics">
      <listOfCurves>
        <curve id="c_S" xDataReference="dg_time" yDataReference="dg_S"/>
        <curve id="c_P" xDataReference="dg_time" yDataReference="dg_P"/>
      </listOfCurves>
    </plot2D>
  </listOfOutputs>
</sedML>

<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="MM_Enzyme" name="Michaelis-Menten Kinetics">
    <listOfCompartments><compartment id="cytosol" size="1.0" constant="true"/></listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="S" compartment="cytosol" initialConcentration="10.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="P" compartment="cytosol" initialConcentration="0.0" constant="false"/>
    </listOfSpecies>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="Vmax" value="1.5" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="Km" value="2.0" constant="true"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfReactions>
      <reaction id="R_cat" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="S" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="P" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw><formula>(Vmax * S) / (Km + S)</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
    </listOfReactions>
  </model>
</sbml>

title: Steady-State Equilibrium Analysis of Genetic Toggle Switch
description: SED-ML steadyState solver protocol computing equilibrium repressor concentrations for a bistable genetic toggle switch SBML model with tabular report output.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sedML xmlns="http://sed-ml.org/sed-ml/level1/version4" level="1" version="4">
  <listOfModels>
    <model id="model_toggle" name="Genetic Toggle Switch" language="urn:sedml:language:sbml" source="toggle.sbml"/>
  </listOfModels>
  <listOfSimulations>
    <steadyState id="sim_ss" name="Newton-Raphson Steady State">
      <algorithm kisaoID="KISAO:0000407" name="NLEQ2"/>
    </steadyState>
  </listOfSimulations>
  <listOfTasks>
    <task id="task_ss" name="Compute Equilibrium" modelReference="model_toggle" simulationReference="sim_ss"/>
  </listOfTasks>
  <listOfDataGenerators>
    <dataGenerator id="dg_u" name="Repressor U">
      <listOfVariables>
        <variable id="u" target="/sbml:sbml/sbml:model/sbml:listOfSpecies/sbml:species[@id='u']" taskReference="task_ss"/>
      </listOfVariables>
      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>u</ci></math>
    </dataGenerator>
    <dataGenerator id="dg_v" name="Repressor V">
      <listOfVariables>
        <variable id="v" target="/sbml:sbml/sbml:model/sbml:listOfSpecies/sbml:species[@id='v']" taskReference="task_ss"/>
      </listOfVariables>
      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>v</ci></math>
    </dataGenerator>
  </listOfDataGenerators>
  <listOfOutputs>
    <report id="report_ss" name="Steady-State Repressor Table">
      <listOfDataSets>
        <dataSet id="ds_u" label="u_ss" dataReference="dg_u"/>
        <dataSet id="ds_v" label="v_ss" dataReference="dg_v"/>
      </listOfDataSets>
    </report>
  </listOfOutputs>
</sedML>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="ToggleSwitch" name="Genetic Toggle Switch">
    <listOfCompartments><compartment id="cell" size="1.0" constant="true"/></listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="u" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="5.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="v" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="0.2" constant="false"/>
    </listOfSpecies>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="alpha" value="10.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="n" value="2.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="kd" value="1.0" constant="true"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfReactions>
      <reaction id="R_u_syn" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="u" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="v"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>alpha / (1 + pow(v, n))</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_u_deg" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="u" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kd * u</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_v_syn" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="v" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="u"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>alpha / (1 + pow(u, n))</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_v_deg" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="v" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kd * v</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
    </listOfReactions>
  </model>
</sbml>

title: RepeatedTask Parameter Scan over Oscillator Rate Constant
description: SED-ML repeatedTask protocol performing a uniform linear parameter sweep across predation rate beta in a companion Lotka-Volterra SBML oscillator.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sedML xmlns="http://sed-ml.org/sed-ml/level1/version4" level="1" version="4">
  <listOfModels>
    <model id="model_osc" name="Lotka-Volterra Oscillator" language="urn:sedml:language:sbml" source="oscillator.sbml"/>
  </listOfModels>
  <listOfSimulations>
    <uniformTimeCourse id="sim_osc" name="CVODE Integration" initialTime="0" outputStartTime="0" outputEndTime="40" numberOfSteps="200">
      <algorithm kisaoID="KISAO:0000019" name="CVODE"/>
    </uniformTimeCourse>
  </listOfSimulations>
  <listOfTasks>
    <task id="task_base" name="Single Run" modelReference="model_osc" simulationReference="sim_osc"/>
    <repeatedTask id="task_scan" name="Beta Parameter Scan" range="range_beta" resetModel="true">
      <listOfRanges>
        <uniformRange id="range_beta" start="0.01" end="0.05" numberOfSteps="4" type="linear"/>
      </listOfRanges>
      <listOfChanges>
        <setValue modelReference="model_osc" target="/sbml:sbml/sbml:model/sbml:listOfParameters/sbml:parameter[@id='beta']/@value" range="range_beta">
          <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>range_beta</ci></math>
        </setValue>
      </listOfChanges>
      <listOfSubTasks>
        <subTask order="1" task="task_base"/>
      </listOfSubTasks>
    </repeatedTask>
  </listOfTasks>
  <listOfDataGenerators>
    <dataGenerator id="dg_time" name="Time">
      <listOfVariables>
        <variable id="t" symbol="urn:sedml:symbol:time" taskReference="task_scan"/>
      </listOfVariables>
      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>t</ci></math>
    </dataGenerator>
    <dataGenerator id="dg_prey" name="Prey Population">
      <listOfVariables>
        <variable id="Prey" target="/sbml:sbml/sbml:model/sbml:listOfSpecies/sbml:species[@id='Prey']" taskReference="task_scan"/>
      </listOfVariables>
      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>Prey</ci></math>
    </dataGenerator>
  </listOfDataGenerators>
  <listOfOutputs>
    <plot2D id="plot_scan" name="Prey Oscillation Parameter Scan">
      <listOfCurves>
        <curve id="c_prey" xDataReference="dg_time" yDataReference="dg_prey"/>
      </listOfCurves>
    </plot2D>
  </listOfOutputs>
</sedML>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="Oscillator" name="Lotka-Volterra Oscillator">
    <listOfCompartments><compartment id="hab" size="1.0" constant="true"/></listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="Prey" compartment="hab" initialConcentration="30.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="Pred" compartment="hab" initialConcentration="8.0" constant="false"/>
    </listOfSpecies>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="alpha" value="0.5" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="beta" value="0.025" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="gamma" value="0.7" constant="true"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfReactions>
      <reaction id="R_grow" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="Prey" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="Prey" stoichiometry="2"/></listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw><formula>alpha * Prey</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_eat" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="Prey" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="Pred" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw><formula>beta * Prey * Pred</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_die" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="Pred" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>gamma * Pred</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
    </listOfReactions>
  </model>
</sbml>

title: Multi-Model Comparison: Wild-Type vs Knockout Mutant
description: Comparative SED-ML experiment executing identical CVODE trajectories across wild-type and catalytic-mutant SBML models and plotting their differential product ratio.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sedML xmlns="http://sed-ml.org/sed-ml/level1/version4" level="1" version="4">
  <listOfModels>
    <model id="model_wt" name="Wild-Type Pathway" language="urn:sedml:language:sbml" source="wt.sbml"/>
    <model id="model_mut" name="Reduced-Activity Mutant" language="urn:sedml:language:sbml" source="mutant.sbml"/>
  </listOfModels>
  <listOfSimulations>
    <uniformTimeCourse id="sim_comp" name="Comparative Time Course" initialTime="0" outputStartTime="0" outputEndTime="30" numberOfSteps="150">
      <algorithm kisaoID="KISAO:0000019" name="CVODE"/>
    </uniformTimeCourse>
  </listOfSimulations>
  <listOfTasks>
    <task id="task_wt" name="Wild-Type Run" modelReference="model_wt" simulationReference="sim_comp"/>
    <task id="task_mut" name="Mutant Run" modelReference="model_mut" simulationReference="sim_comp"/>
  </listOfTasks>
  <listOfDataGenerators>
    <dataGenerator id="dg_time" name="Time">
      <listOfVariables>
        <variable id="t" symbol="urn:sedml:symbol:time" taskReference="task_wt"/>
      </listOfVariables>
      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>t</ci></math>
    </dataGenerator>
    <dataGenerator id="dg_P_wt" name="Wild-Type Product">
      <listOfVariables>
        <variable id="P_wt" target="/sbml:sbml/sbml:model/sbml:listOfSpecies/sbml:species[@id='P']" taskReference="task_wt"/>
      </listOfVariables>
      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>P_wt</ci></math>
    </dataGenerator>
    <dataGenerator id="dg_P_mut" name="Mutant Product">
      <listOfVariables>
        <variable id="P_mut" target="/sbml:sbml/sbml:model/sbml:listOfSpecies/sbml:species[@id='P']" taskReference="task_mut"/>
      </listOfVariables>
      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>P_mut</ci></math>
    </dataGenerator>
  </listOfDataGenerators>
  <listOfOutputs>
    <plot2D id="plot_wt_vs_mut" name="Wild-Type vs Mutant Product Accumulation">
      <listOfCurves>
        <curve id="c_wt" xDataReference="dg_time" yDataReference="dg_P_wt"/>
        <curve id="c_mut" xDataReference="dg_time" yDataReference="dg_P_mut"/>
      </listOfCurves>
    </plot2D>
  </listOfOutputs>
</sedML>

  <model id="MutantPathway" name="Reduced-Activity Mutant Pathway">
    <listOfCompartments><compartment id="cell" size="1.0" constant="true"/></listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="S" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="15.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="P" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="0.0" constant="false"/>
    </listOfSpecies>
    <listOfParameters><parameter id="kcat" value="0.12" constant="true"/></listOfParameters>
    <listOfReactions>
      <reaction id="R1" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="S" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="P" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kcat * S</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
    </listOfReactions>
  </model>
</sbml>

title: Cardiac Action Potential Pacing Protocol on CellML
description: Cross-standard SED-ML electrophysiological pacing simulation protocol targeting a companion CellML ventricular myocyte membrane action potential model.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sedML xmlns="http://sed-ml.org/sed-ml/level1/version4" level="1" version="4">
  <listOfModels>
    <model id="model_cardiac" name="Beeler-Reuter Ventricular Cell" language="urn:sedml:language:cellml" source="beeler_reuter.cellml"/>
  </listOfModels>
  <listOfSimulations>
    <uniformTimeCourse id="sim_pace" name="1 Hz Ventricular Pacing" initialTime="0" outputStartTime="0" outputEndTime="1000" numberOfSteps="500">
      <algorithm kisaoID="KISAO:0000019" name="CVODE">
        <listOfAlgorithmParameters>
          <algorithmParameter kisaoID="KISAO:0000209" name="relative tolerance" value="1e-6"/>
        </listOfAlgorithmParameters>
      </algorithm>
    </uniformTimeCourse>
  </listOfSimulations>
  <listOfTasks>
    <task id="task_pace" name="Pacing Run" modelReference="model_cardiac" simulationReference="sim_pace"/>
  </listOfTasks>
  <listOfDataGenerators>
    <dataGenerator id="dg_time" name="Time (ms)">
      <listOfVariables>
        <variable id="t" symbol="urn:sedml:symbol:time" taskReference="task_pace"/>
      </listOfVariables>
      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>t</ci></math>
    </dataGenerator>
    <dataGenerator id="dg_V" name="Membrane Voltage (mV)">
      <listOfVariables>
        <variable id="V" target="/cellml:model/cellml:component[@name='membrane']/cellml:variable[@name='V']" taskReference="task_pace"/>
      </listOfVariables>
      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><ci>V</ci></math>
    </dataGenerator>
  </listOfDataGenerators>
  <listOfOutputs>
    <plot2D id="plot_ap" name="Cardiac Action Potential">
      <listOfCurves>
        <curve id="c_V" xDataReference="dg_time" yDataReference="dg_V"/>
      </listOfCurves>
    </plot2D>
  </listOfOutputs>
</sedML>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<model name="beeler_reuter_simplified" xmlns="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/1.1#">
  <units name="ms"><unit prefix="milli" units="second"/></units>
  <units name="mV"><unit prefix="milli" units="volt"/></units>
  <component name="membrane">
    <variable name="time" units="ms"/>
    <variable name="V" units="mV" initial_value="-84.6"/>
    <variable name="V_rest" units="mV" initial_value="-84.6"/>
    <variable name="tau" units="ms" initial_value="15.0"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply><diff/><bvar><ci>time</ci></bvar><ci>V</ci></apply>
        <apply><divide/><apply><minus/><ci>V_rest</ci><ci>V</ci></apply><ci>tau</ci></apply>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>
</model>
